msg: warning: Variable mod is freed although not dynamically allocted!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 6e2b75740be.c (Linux module loader). 'Variable mod is freed although not dynamically allocated!' at line 60 ('free(module_core(mod))'), presence condition True. module_core(mod) is mod[1], which was set to 'ptr' (malloc'd at line 38). So module_core(mod) points to dynamically allocated memory. The alarm's claim that it is not dynamically allocated is factually incorrect. The actual issue at line 60 is that after the aliasing at line 48, freeing module_core(mod) leaves mod as a dangling pointer — but that's a use-after-free issue, not 'freed non-dynamic memory.'
